title: Data Operations - Disconnected Scenario
description: Learn CRUD operations in disconnected scenario and entity graph handling.
longDescription: This module covers Create, Update, Delete operations in disconnected scenario and working with disconnected entity graphs using different EF Core methods.
whatYouLearn: Perform CRUD operations in disconnected scenario
Insert relational data and multiple records
Handle entity graphs with different methods
Understand EntityState behavior in disconnected graphs
